topic: Pick a theme for the school science fair

scenario.topic: Pick a theme for the school science fair
scenario.opening_question: What kind of science fair theme do we want that balances creativity, cost, and student engagement?

options.name: Renewable Energy Projects Showcase
options.upside: Encourages practical learning about sustainable technologies
options.tradeoff: Requires technical equipment that may be costly and complex to set up
options.concern: Some students may find the technical concepts challenging
options.best_for: promoting environmental awareness and hands-on STEM skills

options.name: Everyday Chemistry Experiments
options.upside: Affordable and accessible with familiar materials
options.tradeoff: Less visually impressive compared to large-scale projects
options.concern: Safety concerns with handling chemicals even if common
options.best_for: engaging students with relatable, simple experiments

options.name: Robotics and Automation Demonstrations
options.upside: Highly engaging and showcases cutting-edge technology
options.tradeoff: Maxes out the budget and requires significant time investment
options.concern: May exclude students without prior coding or robotics experience
options.best_for: showcasing advanced STEM skills and teamwork

options.name: Local Ecosystem Biodiversity Study
options.upside: Promotes outdoor learning and environmental stewardship
options.tradeoff: Dependent on weather and may require off-campus trips
options.concern: Logistical challenges with coordinating outdoor activities
options.best_for: connecting students with nature and observational science

shared_context: The science fair will be held in 6 weeks at the school gymnasium
The total budget for materials and decorations is $500
The decision group has exactly 3 participants who will help organize

personas.name: Felix
personas.background: Felix is interested in advanced STEM fields and enjoys projects that involve programming and robotics.
personas.private_goal: He wants the science fair to showcase cutting-edge technology and teamwork skills.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.name: Kira
personas.background: Kira values structure and reliability, preferring projects that challenge students but stay within a manageable scope.
personas.private_goal: She wants a theme that maximizes student engagement without risking safety or overextending resources.
personas.rejection_reason: Rejects Everyday Chemistry due to safety concerns with handling chemicals.
